title: Attention Is All You Need
summary:
recurrent neural networks , long short - term memory and gated recurrent neural networks have been firmly established as state of the art approaches in sequence modeling and transduction problems such as language modeling and machine translation . 
 the dominant sequence transduction models are based on complex recurrent orconvolutional neural networks that include an encoder and a decoder . the best
performing models also connect the encoder to the decoder through an attention mechanism . in this work we propose a new simple network architecture , the Transformer , dispensing with recurrence and convolutions
entirely .experiments on two machine translation tasks show these models to be superior in quality while being more parallelizable and requiring significantly
less time to train . our model achieves 28.4 bLEu on the watson machine translation task , improving over the existing best results , includingensembles , by over 2 bleeu . on the same task , 
 our model establishes a new single-model state-of-the - art score of 41.8 after 3.5 days on eight graphics cards , a small fraction of the training costs of the best models from the literature .
key_findings: Introduced the Transformer architecture that eliminates recurrence and convolutions.
Achieved superior performance in machine translation tasks compared to existing models.
Established a new single-model state-of-the-art score of 41.8 on the Watson machine translation task.
Demonstrated significant improvements in training time and parallelization.
methodology: The study proposes a novel architecture called the Transformer, which utilizes an attention mechanism without relying on recurrent or convolutional networks. Experiments were conducted on machine translation tasks to evaluate performance.
limitations: The model's performance may vary with different datasets not covered in the study.
Potential overfitting issues were not extensively addressed.
The architecture's applicability to other sequence modeling tasks remains to be explored.
future_work: Investigate the application of the Transformer architecture to other domains beyond machine translation.
Explore enhancements to the attention mechanism for improved performance.
Conduct further studies on the scalability of the model with larger datasets.
